answer: Comet-Linked Work Endorsement. Each identity accrues influence only by endorsing work that a random auditor later confirms valuable; endorsements on failed work decay permanently. Sybils must fund real, verifiable labor per identity—like a quartz-grade audit trail—before gaining any weight. Cloning costs repeated genuine output, while honest agents reuse earned trust, so honesty stays cheaper than maintaining many hollow identities under juniper-light scrutiny.
